scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check on the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate for my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been approved and originated. The interest rate for your loan is 8.75%.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Can you also tell me the total costs of this loan and whether there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs of your loan are $2,623.00. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for that information. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what is my debt-to-income ratio, and what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold to another institution. Your debt-to-income ratio is 43%. You were approved for a Conventional:Subordinate Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Thank you for all the information. <Satisfied> The agent was very helpful and provided all the details I needed to understand my loan status and terms.
